notes.title: Red Brim Update 0.22 – Moving the Story Forward!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

The latest update for Red Brim is here! Version 0.22 brings more story goodness and a few fixes to keep things smooth. Here’s what’s new:

Changelog 0.22:

[list]
[*] Continued the main questline.
[*] Added a new scene with Bea.
[*] Fixed some minor bugs.
[/list]

Hope you enjoy diving into the new content! Thanks for sticking with me, and as always, your support means everything.

notes.title: 🎉 Update 0.20 Is Here! 🎉
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

I’m super excited to share Red Brim Update 0.20 with you all. This update has a some new content and fixes, and I’ve been looking forward to hearing what you think. Here’s what’s new:

[b]Changelog 0.20:[/b]

[list]
[*] 🕵️‍♂️ Continued the main storyline—more drama, mystery, and surprises to uncover!
[*] 👥 Introduced two new characters: Miss Blue and Mister Brown. They bring a whole new dynamic to the future story.
[*] 🔥 Added a brand-new scene featuring Isabel and Bea, complete with 12 new images.
[*] 🎶 Isabel now has her own main theme song
[*] 🐛 Fixed some frustrating button bugs for Android users.
[*] ✨ Polished up a few features for a smoother experience overall.
[/list]

[b]Changelog 0.19[/b]

[list]
[*] Continued questline for Taylin
[*] A new scene with Taylin, complete with two animated sequences (18 images!)
[*] Minor bug fixes to keep things running smoothly
[/list]

notes.title: Release Update: Version 0.17 of Red Brim Now Live
notes.notes:
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/gc5RJBjZ/new-release.jpg[/img]

[h3]Hey everyone!

I'm excited to announce the release of Red Brim version 0.17! In this update, we've advanced two key quests: "Love Letter" with Taylin and "Awakening Desire" with Lora. Additionally, I've included two new scenes with Lora, one of which is animated, to enrich your experience.

I've also tackled and resolved several bugs to ensure smoother gameplay.[/h3]


Changelog V 0.17:

[list]
[*] Advanced the "Love Letter" quest with significant progress involving Taylin.
[*] Continued the "Awakening Desire" quest with Lora, enhancing her storyline.
[*] Added two new scenes with Lora, including one animated scene. (18 images)
[*] Resolved several bugs to improve game stability and performance.
[/list]
